Isla

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Noticed you invited someone to the team. Hope the handoff's been smooth -- anything I can help with?

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 and one invite sent (facts), so momentum exists, but Isla explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:dd6a7edd], signalling a pause with 8 days left. No tickets, no further activity since 9/23. Evaluation stance makes unaided key milestone possible but not likely.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for being straight with me -- totally fair to take another week to decide, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that tends to make the evaluation clearer: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing real work inside your project is usually what tells a team whether it fits. If it's useful, I'm happy to help you get one piece of actual work set up inside your existing project -- just reply and I'll take it from there.

Otherwise, I'll check back next week.

Best,
Chidi
